question_stem: A particle of mass $m$ and charge $q$ is in a uniform electric field of strength $E$. The particle has acceleration $a$ due to the field.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The particle has a charge of $4e$ where $e$ is the elementary charge. The electric field strength is $3.5 \times 10^4 \text{V m}^{-1}$. The acceleration of the particle is $1.5 \times 10^{12} \text{m s}^{-2}$.

Use the expression in (a) to show that the mass of the particle is $9.0\text{ u}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: The particle is a nucleus. State the number of protons and the number of neutrons in the nucleus.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.part_stem:
